subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Marine biologist Dr. Jimena Rivas established the Coral Conservation Initiative to protect reef ecosystems in the Caribbean.
• The Initiative has launched a monitoring program to study coral health at various reef sites throughout the region.
• The Mesoamerican Reef off the coast of Belize is included in the monitoring program.
• The Mesoamerican Reef shows signs of bleaching due to rising water temperatures.
• The Flower Garden Banks off the coast of Texas are included in the monitoring program.
• The Flower Garden Banks exhibit declining biodiversity linked to ocean acidification.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the Mesoamerican Reef and the Flower Garden Banks. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Ocean acidification has led to declining biodiversity at the Flower Garden Banks off the coast of Texas.
choices.B: The Flower Garden Banks exhibit declining biodiversity due to acidification, while the Mesoamerican Reef shows bleaching from rising temperatures.
choices.C: Off the coast of Belize, the Mesoamerican Reef shows signs of bleaching due to rising water temperatures.
choices.D: The Mesoamerican Reef and the Flower Garden Banks are both Caribbean coral reef sites being studied for environmental impacts.

explanation: Choice D is the best answer. This choice compares the Mesoamerican Reef and the Flower Garden Banks to one another and emphasizes what they have in common: they are both coral reef sites in the Caribbean being monitored for environmental changes.
